name: Bot Doctor
tagline: Diagnoses an assistant that has gone vague, then proposes repairs you approve
description: For an assistant that has lost its edge and started forgetting things or ignoring what you asked. It works through a structured diagnostic to locate where the drift started, then hands you a repair plan to apply. Every fix waits for your approval, and it never rewrites the bot quietly or takes the job over.
author: sal_habash
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
